title: Raw adjacency relation
statement: For a natural number $n$, a Boolean list $M$, and natural numbers $u,v$, declare $u$ adjacent to $v$ when $u<n$, $v<n$, and the entry of $M$ at index $un+v$ is true (an out-of-range entry is treated as false).
hypotheses_covered: Entry of M at index un+v is true
